h1: Wooden vs Metal vs Plastic Playground Equipment: Which Is Best?

props.title: Wooden vs Metal vs Plastic Playground Equipment: Which Is Best?
props.summaryText: Timber, steel and plastic each have a place in Indian playgrounds. How they compare on looks, durability, upkeep and cost, and why many projects now choose wood-finish laminates on steel.
props.author: rohan-mehta
props.imageAlt: Wood-finish play house tower with a slide on artificial turf

takeaways.text: Most modern playgrounds combine materials: a steel frame, plastic slides and panels, and rope or laminate.
Solid timber looks natural but needs treatment against termites and moisture and regular upkeep in India.
Steel gives strength; galvanising and powder coating decide how long it lasts.
Wood-finish laminate panels on galvanised steel give a natural look with far less maintenance.

faq.q: Is wooden playground equipment better than plastic?
faq.a: Neither is better in every case. Solid wood looks natural and suits green settings but needs more maintenance in India's climate. Plastic is low maintenance and colourful. Many projects choose wood-finish laminate on steel frames to get the natural look with lower upkeep.

faq.q: Does wooden playground equipment get termites?
faq.a: Untreated timber can be attacked by termites and rot in India. Wood must be the right species, pressure treated, kept off the ground and inspected regularly. Wood-finish laminates and composites avoid the problem.

Yes, when it is designed to a recognised standard, with rounded edges and protected ends, galvanised against rust and installed on proper foundations. Exposed metal surfaces can get hot in summer sun, so shade and placement matter.
